dedupe_keys.name: national core infrastructure status statistics of korea ministry of the interior and safety open api

description: The Korean Ministry of the Interior and Safety publishes an open API on the public data portal with the national core infrastructure status statistics from its annual statistical yearbook. The API covers the disaster management chapter on national core infrastructure (the facilities the government designates as critical), giving statistics by core infrastructure sector, the number of designated facilities and the designated facilities by ministry and type. It is a REST API returning XML, registered in October 2022 and last modified in June 2025, with automatic approval for development and operational accounts and a development quota of 10,000 calls; the whole yearbook can also be downloaded as PDF from the ministry's website. Use is free and the licence places no restriction on use. Caveats: the statistics are aggregate counts of designated facilities, not locations, and an API key from the portal is needed. Coverage is the Republic of Korea. It supports critical infrastructure exposure and planning analysis, such as comparing how many designated facilities each sector and ministry manages; related records are the Ireland National Risk Assessment 2023 and the UK National Risk Register 2025.
